basis: The chart's y-axis is labeled 'Value' with a 0–65 numerical scale, and the blue markers' vertical positions encode the feedback share. The 'Other' marker is at the lowest vertical position (approximately 23), which is lower than the 'Service Delivery' marker (approximately 31) and all other markers. Although the percentage inscriptions above the markers (e.g., 18% for Service Delivery, 38% for Other) do not match the marker heights, the marker positions are the primary visual encoding of the 'Value' on the y-axis. Therefore, 'Other' represents the lowest feedback share.
option_label: Route Other to low-feedback coverage follow-up
